suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Remove 'No semicolons at end of statements (follow existing code style)' from Coding Conventions. Prettier is configured with semi: true and the codebase now uses semicolons throughout.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: eslint-prettier-setup feature set semi: true in .prettierrc and ran npm run format on entire codebase. All src/*.ts files now have semicolons. AGENTS.md contradicts this.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update test count from 148 to 156 in Testing section. The shared-test-helper feature added 8 new tests and the pre-existing codebase had some additional tests.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add note about ESLint warn-level rules not failing CI. Specifically no-unused-vars and no-explicit-any are warn-only, so intentional unused vars for testing won't be flagged as errors.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: eslint.config.js sets @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars and @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any to 'warn' rather than 'error'. The original feature spec said 'Intentional lint violation (e.g., unused variable) causes the command to exit non-zero' which will not hold for these specific rules.
